mapper.sql: u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.gender, u.phone, u.email, u.dept_id, u.role_id, u.education, u.hire_date, u.status
mapper.select:
select , d.name as dept_name, r.name as role_name, r.code as role_code, r.level as role_level, (select round(avg(p.score), 1) from perf_record p where p.user_id = u.id) as avg_score from sys_user u join sys_dept d on d.id = u.dept_id join sys_role r on r.id = u.role_id
order by u.id limit #{q.size} offset #{q.offset}

select , d.name as dept_name, r.name as role_name, r.code as role_code, r.level as role_level, (select round(avg(p.score), 1) from perf_record p where p.user_id = u.id) as avg_score from sys_user u join sys_dept d on d.id = u.dept_id join sys_role r on r.id = u.role_id
order by u.id

select , d.name as dept_name, r.name as role_name, r.code as role_code, r.level as role_level from sys_user u join sys_dept d on d.id = u.dept_id join sys_role r on r.id = u.role_id where u.id = #{id}

select u.id, u.username, u.password, u.real_name, u.gender, u.phone, u.email, u.dept_id, u.role_id, u.education, u.hire_date, u.status, d.name as dept_name, r.name as role_name, r.code as role_code, r.level as role_level from sys_user u join sys_dept d on d.id = u.dept_id join sys_role r on r.id = u.role_id where u.username = #{username}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user (username, password, real_name, gender, phone, email, dept_id, role_id, education, hire_date, status) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{deptId}, #{roleId}, #{education}, #{hireDate}, #{status})
mapper.update: update sys_user set real_name = #{realName}, gender = #{gender}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, dept_id = #{deptId}, role_id = #{roleId}, education = #{education}, hire_date = #{hireDate}, status = #{status} where id = #{id}
update sys_user set password = #{password} where id = #{id}
update sys_user set role_id = #{roleId} where id = #{id}
